Giant Las Vegas Tuesday Night MTB Ride

Las Vegas, NV · Blue Diamond / Cottonwood Valley · Mountain bike

No-drop

Giant Las Vegas Tuesday Night MTB Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Las Vegas, NV. It rolls every Tuesday at 7:00 pm from Town of Blue Diamond. About 8–15 miles, two groups: faster 12–15 mi and casual 8–12 mi. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: two groups: faster 12–15 mi and casual 8–12 mi. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @giantlasvegas the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Giant Las Vegas Tuesday Night MTB Ride group ride

Night mountain bike ride on the Cottonwood Valley trails out of Blue Diamond. Two groups, both no-drop, about two hours. Bring lights. Call the shop (702-844-2453, option 1) with questions.
